title: Choo-choo train, the one line again, after the shake-down
model: Purple Skippy: Claude Code on Skippy Core's coder (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, MTP, Q8), local and free, with the tuned harness (the workshop prompt as of commit 8f5f8d1, compaction hook included) and the same one-line request as v1
verdict: The best purple Skippy build so far, and the first with everything where it belongs: an iron locomotive with a domed boiler, cab, spoked wheels, cowcatcher and a smoke plume, an oak tender and a red and a blue passenger car, all coupled and on the track in a line, a station with platform, pillars and lamps beside it. It found and fixed its own bug (866 blocks below the ground) with the runtime, and finished clean: zero floating parts, nothing outside the grid. Weaker: it filled the whole 256 x 256 plot with several hundred trees in a rigid lattice (its summary says 60+), which swamps the train, and the locomotive is pale and plain next to the coloured cars. Nine minutes, against 13 for v1 and 42 for the coached v3.
